question: Which applications are named rc_trigger_1?
note: Attribute comparison with '='. Quoted value string. Scope 'all' = class Application and subclasses.

question: List all applications except rc_trigger_1
note: '!=' comparison on string attribute Name.

question: Find hosts whose name starts with pc-tdaq-onl
note: '~=' is regex comparison (added tdaq-01-09-00). Value is an (unquoted-in-pattern) regex string.

question: Get all hosts matching the glob-like pattern pc-tdaq*
note: Translate shell glob to regex: '*' -> '.*'. OKS has no glob operator; only regex '~='.

question: Which readout applications handle PMT detectors?
note: Enum attribute SubDetector (range PMT,WireChamber). Enum values are still quoted strings in queries.

question: Which readouts are NOT for PMT?
note: '!=' on enum attribute.

question: Run-control applications with Timeout greater than 25 seconds
note: Numeric '>' on u16 attribute Timeout (range 1..3600). Value quoted despite being numeric.

question: Run-control applications with Timeout below 30 seconds
note: '<' comparison.

question: Applications with Timeout at least 20 seconds
note: '>='. 20 is the init-value; boundary included.

question: Applications with Timeout no more than 120 seconds
note: '<=' comparison.

question: Apps whose name is not the default 'Unknown'
note: init-value of Name is 'Unknown'; useful sanity filter.

question: Apps named 'Fake' or with Timeout over 500
note: Logical OR joins two full scoped expressions. Grammar: (or expr expr ...).

question: Applications whose Timeout is NOT less than 25
note: NOT wraps a whole scoped expression; equivalent to (all ("Timeout" "25" >=)).

question: RC applications that control application rc-readout-1
note: Relationship 'some': at least one referenced object matches the inner query. Inner scope 'all' again includes subclasses.

question: RC applications that control only PMT readouts (every controlled app is PMT)
note: Relationship 'all': EVERY referenced object must satisfy the subquery. Distinguish from 'some' (at least one).

question: Which containers contain object o1-good?
note: object-id comparison, only '=' allowed. Matches Container objects whose Contains list includes the Element with id o1-good.

question: Containers whose Root is exactly o1-good
note: Single-valued relationship Root; 'some' works for single refs too.

question: Containers that do NOT contain o1-good
note: NOT combined with relationship+object-id.

question: Elements referenced from o1-good-container via Contains
note: Note direction: query finds objects whose relationship points AT the given id.

question: All applications running on host lxplus001
note: Canonical example from CERN release notes; object-id of a Computer is its hostname.

question: Partitions with an app running on host abc
note: Nested relationships: Partitions -> some partition -> RunsOn -> object-id. Each relationship level has its own inner scope.

question: Objects whose 'my-relationship' points to object test
note: Generic form from release notes.

question: Objects of class Container with Enum 'one' AND Date 20240827
note: Date stored as ISO string 'YYYYMMDD'; compare with '='.

question: Elements created after 20240827
note: Dates are ISO strings; lexical > works for YYYYMMDD.

question: Elements with Float value above 3.0
note: float attribute; value quoted, parsed as double.

question: Elements with Boolean true
note: bool attribute; data file stores 1/0, but weak typing accepts 'true'/'false' in the query string.

question: Elements whose Class attribute is Container
note: 'class' attribute type holds the name of another class; compare with a quoted class name.

question: Elements with an empty ArrayString
note: Multi-value attribute with empty value list; value is empty string.

question: Containers whose Contains includes at least one Element with IntS32 = -1
note: Relationship + inner attribute query; inner 'all' needed because Contains refs are of class Element (no subclasses here, harmless).

question: Containers holding only elements named like 'o1-*'
note: 'all' with relationship: every contained element must match. Inner query has no Name attr on Element in test data - illustrative.

question: Only class itself, not subclasses: this scope
note: 'this' = exactly the queried class (no subclass expansion); 'all' = class + subclasses.

question: Tutorial cars with Max Speed over 200 (older example)
note: Illustrative: original OKS tutorial schema had class Car; attribute names can contain spaces and must be quoted.

question: Containers containing o1-good AND o1-good2
note: AND of two relationship conditions - both must hold.

question: Containers containing o1-good or o1-good2
note: OR of two relationship conditions.

question: Apps with Name rc_trigger_1 that are NOT readouts
note: Mixed AND + NOT; every branch is a full scoped expression.

question: Hosts running at least one app and none named 'X'
note: '.*' regex matches every non-empty string.

question: Query file: the format is plain text
note: Queries can be stored in .query files and loaded from the Query window; format is simple Lisp-like text, editable by hand.

question: Run oks_dump to list all objects of class RCApplication
note: -c selects class, -f selects data file(s). Exit code 0 = OK.

question: Run a query from the command line
note: -q passes a query string; note escaping of quotes in shell.

question: What do the oks_dump exit codes mean?
query_oks: 0=OK 1=bad CLI 2=bad OKS file 3=bad query 4=class not found 5=dangling refs
note: Documented mapping; useful for test harness assertions.

question: Path query: find RunControlApplication for a partition via OnlineInfrastructure
note: Real example from release notes: path-to destination 'id@class', direct = first-level rels, nested = further levels.

question: What config did run 380689 use?
note: Version selector 'tag:<run>@<node>' for git-backed OKS.

question: What config is at git commit 6800fe3b?
note: Version selector 'hash:<git sha>'

question: Config as of 2020-08-02 10:00:00
note: Version selector 'date:YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' - quote in shell due to space.

question: Programmatically list all stored versions of a repository
note: C++ API OksRepository::get_repository_versions; returns list of version strings (used to pick a version selector).

question: Show summary of a repository (run-number tags)
note: Release notes show rn_ls/rn_dump style tools in run-db context; versions can be listed and referenced.

question: GUI: build the same query visually
query_oks: Data Editor -> Class window -> right-click -> Query
note: The Query window builds attribute/relationship/logical expressions; saved query files are editable text.

question: Are queries class-strongly-typed?
query_oks: No - weak typing: same attribute name may match in several classes
note: Quote from QueryWindow.html: a query does not strongly depend on class type.

question: Find partitions with Max Time <= 2 days (172800 s)
note: Illustrative attr name from TDAQ schemas (time in seconds).

question: Find objects of class 'Alarm' with severity >= 2
note: Illustrative: TDAQ has Alarm config in DAQ-Configuration schema (captured).
